ownerDirective: Owner full-rebuild directive for selected homepage games. Restart each selected game from DESIGN_ONLY and run the canonical pipeline from design and art direction through implementation, incremental QA, performance sanity, regression, review and release validation. Do not patch, extend, copy, or use the current gameplay implementation as the implementation base. The current public build may be inspected only for route compatibility, save migration and rollback reference. Keep the existing public URL stable, keep the current public build live until the replacement passes the full QA/release gates, migrate or preserve compatible saves before swap, and only then replace the public build. Mobile-first interaction, real gameplay rather than explanation-first UI, genre-appropriate world/board/map interaction, audiovisual feedback, progression, and zero blocking runtime/console errors are mandatory. Use the existing canonical Vibe2/company pipeline only; do not create a parallel runner or lower any gate. Monster Adventure remains excluded by owner deletion directive.

Use what was learned about the ecosystem to survive stronger pressure and reach the next meaningful objective.
